notes.title: Improving the QOL and More
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In today's update, we focused on Quality of Life improvements and a few other minor adjustments. As you may notice, we've introduced a Russian translation (still a work in progress).

Let us know what you think!

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*]Buffed the Blastfire Cannon and Quantum Detonator cores.
[/list]

[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introduced a Russian translation (currently in progress).
[*]Added a tooltip that displays when a Core needs to be unlocked through a specific achievement, including the achievement's description.
[*]Players can now select their currently equipped Components using control sticks for easier navigation.
[*]Implemented a smnall delay to prevent immediate power-up selection using the spacebar.
[*]Adjusted the Drone Deployer attack by reducing its volume and pitch for better audio balance.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could endlessly accumulate the fire rate bonus from the Rapid Fire Augmentation Overload.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the unlocking of achievements on Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Our First Update: QOL, Meta-progression & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a few days since we launched the game, and we have been working hard to improve it based on the feedback you've provided.

In this initial update, we concentrated on two main areas: improving [b]QOL[/b] and adjusting the balance of [b]meta-progression[/b]. Additionally, we have addressed and fixed the bugs you reported.

Also, we are working on some new game content for the next big update!

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Energy collected by Spiders.
[*]Reduced the chance of unlocking a Legendary Component.
[*]Decreased the invulnerability duration of the Dash Surge Augmentation Overload from 1 to 0.7 seconds.
[*]Added a cap to the minimum dash cooldown at 1 second.
[*]Increased the number of elimination needed to activate the Berserk power-up from 25 to 40.
[*]The Gravity Blaster Core can now reload, allowing it to interact with on-reload power-ups.
[*]Increased the Pickup Range of the Magnet Augmentation from +10/20/30/40% to 20/40/60/100%.
[*]Decreased the chance of activating the Magnet Augmentation Overload from 100% to 65%.
[*]Added a new chest type that drops a Magnet, collecting all experience on the ground.
[*]Unlocking the Adversity Protocol on a map for the first time now unlocks it for all cores.
[*]Balanced the achievements to smooth out game progression.
[/list]

[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added dithering to clarify when an object is between the player and the camera.
[*]A tooltip appears when a Core must first be unlocked by a specific achievement.
[*]Added details of passive bonuses to the Destiny Holder window.
[*]Decreased the volume of the Echothrust Ability audio.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a runtime error caused by the Ice Pierce power-up.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the collection of end-game statistics for Furyblade.
[*]Fixed a bug where using the Seeker Launcher core would cause the game to soft-lock.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from collecting the Mythril at the end of a game.
[*]Fixed a bug where excessive dash cooldown reduction locked the dash.
[*]Fixed a bug where excessive movement speed reduction locked movement.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game's resolution was incorrectly set.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the game to crash during gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]JOIN DISCORD[/h2]
If you have any suggestions or would like to engage in a conversation, feel free to join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/ep4t93D93p


- [i]Hubber Studios[/i]

notes.title: Our First Update: How We Improved the Game Demo
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone!
It's been a few weeks since we released the demo and we have been working hard to improve the game based on your feedback.[/h3]

In this first update, we've focused on two key areas: [b]accessibility[/b] and [b]gameplay[/b]. We've put a lot of effort into improving your [b]DPS[/b]. We've also made boss fights and enemies [b]more balanced[/b], so the game won't be unnecessarily punishing.

We've got exciting plans for [b]future updates[/b] too. We're looking to add new maps, weapons, and power-up trees, so there will be even more to explore and discover in the demo.

We want to be [b]transparent[/b] with you, so we'll keep you updated on all the changes we make to the game right here. If it gets too long-winded (let us know), we'll find another way to share all the details with you.

In the demo, you'll get a taste of our game mechanics: challenging and fast-paced battles against hordes of enemies, upgrading your character with augmentations and cores, and creating unique combos with our power-up trees.

Don't forget to wishlist the game!

We can't wait for you to experience the game demo and hope you'll enjoy it just as much as we do!
See you on May 18th, and until then, stay tuned for more updates!
